text: Oh God, You are my Lord, there is no god but You, You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your grace upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me. For no one forgives sins except you. He said: Whoever says it during the day and is certain of it and dies that day before the evening comes, he will be among the people of Paradise, and whoever says it during the night while being certain of it and dies before the morning comes, he will be among the people of Paradise.

When one of you wakes up, let him say: O God, by You we have become in the morning, by You we have entered the evening, by You we live, by You we will die, and to You is the resurrection. And when evening comes, let him say: O God, by you we entered the evening, and by you we became in the morning, and by you we live, and by you we die, and to you is the final destination.

We have become (evening) upon the nature of Islam, the word of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and the religion of our father Abraham, an upright Muslim, and he was not of the polytheists.

Oh God, I ask you for well-being in this world and the hereafter. Oh God, I ask you for forgiveness and well-being in my religion and my world, my family and my money. Oh God, cover my faults and secure my splendor. Oh God, protect me from before me and behind me, to my right and to my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being assassinated from under me.
Oh God, grant me health in my body, O God, grant me health in my hearing, O God, grant me health in my sight, there is no god but You.
Oh God, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. Oh God, I seek refuge in You from the torment of the grave. There is no god but You.

We have become and become (our evening and evening) the kingdom belongs to God, and praise be to God, there is no god but God alone with no partner, to Him belongs dominion and to Him is praise and He is capable of all things. My Lord, I ask you for the good of this day (tonight) and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day (tonight) and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and bad arrogance. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from torment in the Fire and torment in the grave.

O God, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Lord of everything and its Sovereign, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, and the evil of Satan and his polytheism, and from committing evil upon myself, or dragging it to a Muslim.

I am satisfied with God as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - as my Prophet. Whoever says it in the morning and in the evening, God has a right to please him
O Ever-Living, O Ever-Living, by Your mercy I seek help, rectify all my affairs for me, and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.
There is no god but God alone, with no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is capable of all things
Glory be to God, and praise be to Him according to the number of His creation, the satisfaction of Himself, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.
There is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Ever-Subsisting...

In the name of God, with whose name nothing can be harmed on earth or in heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. Whoever says it three times in the morning and three times in the evening, nothing will harm him

Oh God, I have become (evening) bearing witness to You and the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation that You are God, there is no god but You, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.
Oh God, I ask you for useful knowledge, good livelihood, and acceptable deeds

Whoever says: Glory be to God a hundred times before the sun rises and before it sets, is better than a hundred camels. Whoever says: Praise be to God a hundred times before the sun rises and before it sets, is better than a hundred horses that are mounted in the path of God. Whoever says: God is great a hundred times before the sun rises and before it sets, is better than freeing a hundred slaves. Whoever says: There is no god but God alone, with no partner. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him is praise, and He is capable of all things. One hundred times before sunrise and before sunset - no one will come on the Day of Resurrection with a better deed than his, except one who said the same as what he said, or added to it.
